name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4-ollama
description: Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4 4-bit (Ollama library qwen3.8:27b) served by Ollama via configs/ollama/Modelfile.qwen3.8-27b-bench (num_ctx 57344). Thinking on, reasoning_effort pinned to 'medium' (Ollama's default for this model; the model card's headline scores use 'xhigh'). Sampling = model-card thinking-mode settings. Tested on a 24 GB M4 Pro with iogpu.wired_limit_mb=21504. For Qwen4, use the matching Ollama 4-bit build with the same num_ctx, max_tokens and reasoning_effort. unload_between_tasks frees Ollama's prompt cache after every task (otherwise memory grows task by task on a 24 GB Mac).
